kaggle.termination: Notebook deleted by operator after an unobservable multi-hour run; Kaggle subsequently denied access to the version.

dataset.notes: MCQA was generated from public train splits; the held-out clinical battery was not passed to the trainer. No final checkpoint or evaluation artifact was recovered.

known_weaknesses: The notebook wrapper used subprocess.run(stdout=PIPE) and printed only after each child exited; multi-hour training had no live logs or heartbeat.
train.log was written only after the training subprocess returned.
The trainer had no resume_from_checkpoint argument or optimizer/scheduler/RNG resume test.
Checkpoints were local to ephemeral /kaggle/working and were not persistently uploaded during the run.
The run used a row-count mix dominated by MCQA rather than an explicit token-balanced multi-objective schedule.
The probe did not produce a valid model checkpoint, merged model, GGUF, or evaluation result.
checkpoint_validity: invalid-as-final; no checkpoint was recovered and optimizer position cannot be verified
historical_value: Retain as infrastructure and baseline evidence only; do not use weights or metrics as a production result.
